requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §2.3 exit codes
requirements.text: Every command returns exactly one of: 0 (ok), 1 (gate failure), 2 (usage error), 3 (runtime error).

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §2.4 severity enum
requirements.text: Finding severity is exactly one of ERROR, WARNING, INFO (uppercase).

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §2.8 distinct version keys
requirements.text: schemaVersion (report envelopes, MAJOR.MINOR) and specVersion (version/capabilities, full spec release) are never conflated into a single constant.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §4.2 fingerprint algorithm
requirements.text: Finding.fingerprint = sha256:hex(ruleId US location.file US normalizedMessage), with digit runs folded to '#' and whitespace collapsed.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §1.2 .fusa.json load
requirements.text: project.name and standard are read (MUST); at most one of asil/sil/dal is read; the legacy flat project string form is accepted and normalised.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §1.2 .fusa-reqs.json integrity
requirements.text: A duplicate or missing/empty/non-string requirement id surfaces as an ERROR finding rather than being silently merged or dropped.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §9.1 version command
requirements.text: adafusa version prints '<tool> <version>' and, under --format json, {tool, version, specVersion} with no envelope.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §9.1 capabilities command
requirements.text: adafusa capabilities reports the commands, per-command formats, and standards this build actually supports.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §9.1 init command
requirements.text: adafusa init creates .fusa.json and .fusa-reqs.json; --force overwrites; a missing required value with no TTY exits 2, never a placeholder.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §4 check command
requirements.text: adafusa check runs every registered rule, emits a findings[] + summary, and gates (exit 1) on any open ERROR (or WARNING under --strict).

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §5 trace command
requirements.text: adafusa trace computes tracedRequirements/testedRequirements/secTestedRequirements and gates on --req-coverage/--sec-tested/--strict thresholds.

requirements.title: Tool qualification (qualify command)
requirements.text: adafusa qualify runs a known-answer test against every registered rule and writes qualify-report.json.

requirements.title: Release evidence (release command)
requirements.text: adafusa release writes sbom.json (x-FuSa SBOM v1); --full additionally writes provenance.json, artifact-manifest.json, and audit-pack.zip.

requirements.title: Evidence bundling (audit-pack command)
requirements.text: adafusa audit-pack bundles every existing input/generated evidence file plus a manifest.json into a single flat ZIP archive.

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §9.1 report command
requirements.text: adafusa report re-runs analysis fresh and always exits 0 regardless of findings (only usage/runtime errors apply).

requirements.title: x-FuSa spec §1.4 annotation scanning
requirements.text: -- fusa:req / -- fusa:test / -- fusa:sec-test comments are scanned for exactly one requirement id per line, without false-positiving on prose or string-literal content that merely mentions the marker.

requirements.title: Starter Ada coding-standard rule pack
requirements.text: 8 rules (ADA001-ADA008), drawn from the Ada Quality and Style Guide, are registered and match case-insensitively against Ada source (Ada is a case-insensitive language).

requirements.title: Zero-dependency JSON parser/writer
requirements.text: JSON parsing and serialisation are implemented against the Ada standard library only, reject malformed input (RFC 8259) with Json_Error rather than crashing, and bound recursion depth.

requirements.title: Zero-dependency SHA-256
requirements.text: SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4) is implemented against the Ada standard library only and matches the standard test vectors.

requirements.title: Zero-dependency ZIP writer
requirements.text: A STORED-method ZIP archive writer is implemented against the Ada standard library only, producing archives that pass standard unzip integrity checks.

requirements.title: Absolute projectRoot in report output
requirements.text: The projectRoot field emitted by check/trace/report JSON output is resolved to an absolute path, regardless of whether --dir was given as relative or absolute (spec section 3.2, SHOULD).
